title: (Pwn2Own) Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3150 Jupicore External Control of Path Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3150 devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the firmware-update endpoint. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to update firmware. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of the charging controller.
addtionnal_details: Fixed in firmware v1.9.1, available by Aug 12, 2026.https://certvde.com/en/advisories/VDE-2026-008/
